crashReports.label: Crash reports
crashReports.description: Share anonymous crash data to help improve AlterSend

relay.label: Use relay when direct connection fails
relay.description: When devices can't connect directly, transfers are routed through AlterSend's relay. Files stay end-to-end encrypted.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.autoSaveDescription: When off, you'll be asked where to save each transfer.
downloads.mediaToPhotosDescription: When off, they're saved to the AlterSend folder in Files.
downloads.mediaToGalleryDescription: When off, they're saved to your Downloads folder.

pairing.enterCodeHint: Type or paste an invite code shared from another device

account.title: Your subscription
account.paywallLead: Bigger transfers and priority on the relay.
account.haveCodeLink: Already have Pro? Enter your code
account.nothingToRestore: No purchase found on this account.
account.restoreNotMoved: Your subscription could not be moved to this device. Enter your code instead.
account.expiredCode: That subscription has expired. Renew it to keep using Pro.
account.failed: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
account.offline: You appear to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
account.serverError: We couldn't reach our side. Try again in a few minutes.
account.timedOut: We haven't seen a payment yet. If you finished checkout, check again.
account.waitingTitle: Complete your purchase in the browser
account.waitingBody: We'll pick it up automatically once the payment goes through.
account.approvalBody: Your purchase needs approval before it can go through. Pro unlocks as soon as it does — you can close this.
account.saveWarning: It's your only proof of purchase. We can't recover it, because we don't know who you are.
account.codeReplaced: This is a new code — your previous one no longer works. Enter this one on your other devices.
account.savedCodeBody: It's the only way to get your subscription back on another device. We can't recover it for you.
account.copyFailed: Couldn't copy your code — copy it manually before logging out.
account.codeFileWarning: This code is your subscription. Enter it in AlterSend on any device to restore Pro. We never stored it and cannot recover it for you.
account.cancelBody: Pro stays active until the end of the period you have already paid for. This cannot be undone from the app — you would need to subscribe again once the period ends.
account.logOutBody: Logging out removes {{code}} from this device. It is the only way back into Pro, and we cannot recover it.
account.storeUnavailable: In-app purchase isn't available on this device. Buy AlterSend Pro on another device and enter your code here.
account.featurePriority: Priority when the relay is busy
